# @radui1398/pdf-merger-js-node

> Merge PDFs with the Node.js API or the pdf-merge CLI. Supports filesystem paths and Buffer output.

Version: 6.0.0. ESM package.

Install: `npm install @radui1398/pdf-merger-js-node`.

Import: `import PDFMerger from '@radui1398/pdf-merger-js-node'`.

## Documentation

- [Full agent guide](./llms-full.txt): Usage, API declarations, examples and limitations in one file.
- [README](./README.md): Installation, examples and migration instructions.
- [Public types](./dist/index.d.ts): Package-specific TypeScript API.
